title: REQ · Schema rejects spritesheets whose frames or animations disagree with the sheet
summary: Manifest schema validates frame counts against dimensions and animation frame indices
description: Context: assetSchema in game/src/assets/manifest/schema.ts only requires frames and dimensions for spritesheets. Desired behavior: superRefine also reports an issue when frameWidth*frameCount exceeds the width, frameHeight exceeds the height, or an animation frame index is >= frameCount. Expected result: invalid sheets fail parseManifest with path-named errors. Why: catch broken sheets early.
acceptance_criteria: Given a spritesheet with frameCount 3 and width 64 and frameWidth 32, when parsed, then an issue at frames.frameCount is returned
Given an animation referencing frame index 5 with frameCount 2, when parsed, then an issue at animations.<name>.frames is returned
Given the committed manifest, when parsed, then it is ok

preserve: existing error messages for missing frames/dimensions
